name: Lo-fi beat
description: A lo-fi or chill beat: a loop that changes a little every eight bars, with a short break. 48 bars.

sections.name: Intro
sections.tip: The chords alone, filtered or with some vinyl noise, before the drums come in.

sections.name: Loop A
sections.tip: Drums, bass and chords: the main loop. Keep it simple and warm.

sections.name: Loop B
sections.tip: The same loop with something added: a melody, a sample chop or a second line.

sections.name: Loop A
sections.tip: Back to the main loop, with small changes so it doesn't sound copied.

sections.name: Break
sections.tip: Take the drums out, or filter everything, for a moment.

sections.name: Loop B
sections.tip: The fullest version of the loop.

sections.name: Outro
sections.tip: Take parts out one by one, or let the chords ring out.
